subject: general
question: What is a workbook in Excel?

options.text: A collection of cells with related data
A set of predefined formatting styles

solution:
The correct answer is __**4) A file containing multiple worksheets**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An Excel workbook is a **file that contains one or more worksheets**.
 
• Each worksheet within a workbook can hold data, charts, and other information.
 
• Workbooks are used to organize and manage related data in one file, making it easier to analyze and share information.
 
• Users can add, delete, and rename worksheets within a workbook to suit their needs.
 
• The .xlsx file extension is typically used for Excel workbooks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Excel is a powerful tool for data analysis and visualization, widely used in various fields such as finance, research, and administration.
 
• Workbooks can contain various types of data, including numbers, text, formulas, and functions.
 
• Excel provides numerous features for data manipulation, including sorting, filtering, and pivot tables.
 
• Workbooks can be saved in different formats, such as .xls, .csv, and .pdf, depending on the user's needs.
 
• Excel also supports collaboration, allowing multiple users to work on the same workbook simultaneously.
